meta.title: Rana Tadpole V1 · dead on USB
meta.author: DEADBOARD
meta.description: The first version of a real, sold pocket controller (56 parts: RP2040, 20 mouse-switch buttons). USB comes in from a small breakout board over the flat cable (U2). Plugged in, the computer sees nothing, and nothing gets warm. Bench supply: 5 V on +5V (rail name +5V).
hints: Follow the power in: +5V arrives on the flat-cable connector U2 (and the header J3). Measure +5V, then the regulator U1's output (pin 2), then the logic rail 3vDiode after D1 (C9).
Volts on U1's input (pin 3) and nothing on the copper of its output: look closely at that joint. A regulator that is fine inside can still be cut off by a cracked pin.
meta.credits: Rana Tadpole V1 motherboard, by rana-sylvatica; PCB design by Quark. CERN-OHL-S-2.0. Converted and modified (planted fault) for DEADBOARD; no endorsement implied.
